name: First Class: Full Speed!
overview: Beba and Nemac are chasing the national championship and their dreams of GT3 while driving the iconic Yugos. Their team START is led by Gojko, a multiple first class champion for years. Their rivals are the Montenegro team MONTERARI, who are trying to get to the title off the track as well. That nothing is that simple and that the tension is greater when love is involved in the story, will be proven by the club's mechanic who additionally raises the temperature.
